text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of an overdose, serious adverse reactions may occur [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 , 5.4 )] . Stop the infusion of Omegaven until triglyceride levels have normalized and any symptoms have abated. The effects are usually reversible by stopping the lipid infusion. If medically appropriate, further intervention may be indicated. Lipids are not dialyzable from serum.
